text: My daily routine is quite simple, but I follow it carefully. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and some stretching. After a quick breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work on my computer until noon, then take a short break for lunch. In the afternoon, I try to exercise for about thirty minutes, either walking or cycling. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a series. I go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent with this routine helps me feel healthy, focused, and calm every day.
